_note: Pod-local dimensions (D2, revision D2-R5a on params A1-R4a, D-47 re-lay + D-59 aft travel). Shared numbers (pod LE, L x W x H, base, board thickness, pack size, pack nominal centroid, spar station, pitot tip) come from redesign/params/params.json; these are the pod-only ones. Read by subsystems/pod/fusion/pod.py, team/D2/pod_data.py and team/D2/pod_claims.py. Metres unless stated.

nose_block_l_m.note: R5 (D-47): fixed XPS nose block A deleted. This is now the 1 mm thickened-epoxy (microballoon) bond line between the nose wall inside face and the fore faces of the forward stop and the tray front piece (key name kept for C3, F2, A5). x_fs = pod.x_le_m + board t + this + forward-stop t = -0.130 + 0.0048 + 0.001 + 0.003 = -0.1212; nose skin to stop face 8.8 mm (was 14.8). The stop is now backed by the nose wall instead of riding into block A after it breaks (C3, C5 re-check)

fwd_stop_m.note: thickness x height above the tray top x width; printed with the tray; holds 85 N, breaks at ~100 N and rides into the block (CR-C3-06)

pack_aft_face_m.note: pack aft face: CAD pack at the datum pod.pack_x_nominal_m -0.022 (12 mm stack, blue 8 + yellow 4, CR-A1-54) and the 680 g pack at -0.010 (no spacer, on the aft stop, D-59). Pack 0.140 long. Read by F2 harness.py and A5 cad_claims.py; pod.py checks item 0 against pod.pack_x_nominal_m

aft_stop_x_m.note: aft stop face = pod.pack_x_nominal_m + L_pack/2 + pod.pack_aft_travel_m = -0.022 + 0.070 + 0.012 = 0.060 (D-59; was 0.056 at D-47, 0.077 before). The no-spacer station is -0.010 (680 g). Back face 0.063, 2 mm ahead of the tray end 0.065; spar saddle POD-007 stays at x 0.080

aft_stop_m.note: thickness (C3: 3.0 mm, 2 mm root fillet) x top above the pack underside (pack centroid + 2 mm). Printed with the tray rear piece (POD-002). R5a (D-59): at x 0.060 the back face is 0.063, 2 mm ahead of the recess end; C3 sized the stop without the gussets (CL-C3-AFT-STOP-D2, 14.0 vs 15 MPa across layers), so the 2 mm root ribs are a fillet, not a load path. +x load: stop -> tray rear bond -> floor -> pod-wing bond

gusset_m.note: R5a (D-59): two root ribs behind the aft stop at the bay edges, length aft x thickness; with the stop face at 0.060 only 2 mm of tray remain behind it (tray end 0.065), so they shrink 6 -> 2 mm and act as the C3 root fillet at the edges. C3's stop check ignores them (CR-D2-23)

bay_min_m.note: inside L x W x H the pack bay must keep

tray_floor_t_m.note: PETG, 5 layers at 0.2 mm, epoxied full-area to the foam-board floor (CR-C3-01)

pad_t_m.note: closed-cell EVA pads with an anti-slip face. R5: the pack no longer overhangs the recess end (aft face <= 0.056 < 0.065); 2.5 mm kept for the 3.5 mm wire channel under the pack and the bay height

pad_len_m.note: one pad per strap station, centred on the strap slot

window_border_m.note: tray-floor lightening windows: border to ends and slots (x), to the guides (y); R5: a window needs >= 6 mm clear length (was 10)

guide_h_m.note: bay side guides above the tray floor

slot_wall_m.note: foam left between the pod recess end and the spar-slot front face (recess unchanged from R2)

spacer_set_m.note: printed U-spacers behind the pack (POD-008): any even stack 0-28 mm. D-59 (aft stop 0.060): stop-to-stop room beyond the pack and spreader is 39.7 mm, so the crash-safe stack per pack = 39.7 mm - C5 block minimum for that mass: 680 g <= 6 mm, 550 g <= 14 mm, 503 g <= 16 mm. Colour by thickness: 2 white, 4 yellow, 6 green, 8 blue; each pack label carries its stack (D-59): 680 g none, 550 g blue (8), 503 g blue + green (14)

spacer_flown_m.note: spacers in the CAD: the pack at the datum -0.022 with a 12 mm stack (blue 8 + yellow 4), as CR-A1-54 asks; the 550 g flight station is -0.018 with blue alone (D-59). The rest live in the field kit

spacer_bar_m.note: U-spacer leg width and bar (bar height 0.6 x this). R5a: 5 -> 4 mm (-0.4 g on the 12 mm CAD stack) to pay for the D-59 12 mm stack inside the 131 g allocation; bearing on the pack aft face 200 mm2 per 12 mm stack, 0.4 MPa at the 85 N crash load

spreader_t_m.note: printed PETG plate on the pack fore face, full block section

vent_m.note: ram-air inlet (nose wall, top centre) and equal exit (aft wall, top centre): width y x height z; air runs over the pack top

block_groove_m.note: vent groove in the top of the removable crush block and spreader: width x depth (7.8 % of the block section)

strap_w_m.note: hook-and-loop battery strap, rubber-backed, overlap >= 50 mm marked (CR-C3-01)

strap_x_m.note: strap slot centres: quarter points of the 140 mm pack at the middle of the D-47 stations (centroid -0.019). D-59 range -0.024 ... -0.010: the 37 mm slots keep a 20 mm strap on the quarter points for centroids -0.0275 ... -0.0105; the 680 g pack at -0.010 has its straps 0.5 mm forward of its quarter points (strap at the slot end), accepted

strap_slot_m.note: x length (strap 20 mm + 17 mm so the strap follows the pack over the station range) x y width

plate_t_m.note: FC, avionics, PDB and JR plates (part of POD-002), 4 layers at 0.2 mm, epoxied full-area to the floor: no bending to carry (R3 1.5 -> 1.0 mm, R4 1.0 -> 0.8 mm, -1.3 g); the PDB bosses stand on the bonded plate

fc_board_m.note: CoreWing F405 Wing V2 top board alone: footprint x height on 4 gel cubes 5 mm; no screws, no inserts

fc_plate_len_m.note: board 52 mm + 2 x (2 mm clearance + 3 mm end stop)

fc_stop_m.note: end stops at both FC ends: thickness x height x width; 2 mm clear of the board so the gel pads isolate; the guide and side wall bound y

avn_plate_x_m.note: left channel: airspeed sensor (MS4525DO) between the tie posts on foam tape + 1 tie (CR-C6-07); RX crosswise behind it (x -0.0535 ... -0.0405) fully on the plate (R4: aft end -0.044 -> -0.040)

tie_post_m.note: two posts with a 3 x 1.5 mm tie slot each, 24 mm apart, for the airspeed-sensor tie

pdb_plate_x_m.note: left channel: F1's bus board on foam tape between the boss rows and F1's power frame (PWR-006) on 4 nylon spacers over the 4 M3 x 5.7 heat-set inserts (E-PWR-03); R4: starts -0.038 (was -0.042) for the RX (CR-F3-12 b)

pdb_pattern_m.note: square M3 pattern placeholder until F1 names the PDB

boss_d_m.note: boss for an M3 x 5.7 brass heat-set insert (4.0 mm bore)

park_x_m.note: AS150U park zone in the left channel (mated pair 22 x 14 x 55 mm EST): F1's power-frame cradle (PWR-006, CR-F1-16) stands here, reachable through the hatch with the pack in; F2 asks it against the inboard guide (CR-F2-03 b)

ubec_zone_x_m.note: right channel behind the JR tie bar: UBEC on foam tape + 1 tie on a 0.8 mm plate (CR-F1-17), >= 0.10 m from the GPS (CR-F2-03 g)

hatch_aft_x_m.note: hatch opening ends here; fixed aft deck behind it. R5a: every pack (aft face <= 0.060) and the aft stop (back face 0.063) are inside the opening

lip_m.note: nose lip length x thickness; the hatch tongue slides under it

latch_tab_m.note: hook-and-loop latch tab, overlap on the aft deck x width

ant_tube_m.note: antenna A: printed tube through the hatch: OD, bore, top z (element starts here, >= 31 mm from the pack)

ant_tube_xy_m.note: above the receiver in the left channel

nose_ant_m.note: antenna B: printed tube out of the nose below the pitot boom: y, z, OD, bore; through the nose wall and the nose block

foot_y_m.note: handle foot plate span each side

tongue_y_m.note: saddle tongue span each side (R3: narrowed to 14 mm round the tie at 0.036, -2 g)

foot_plate_t_m.note: foot plates and the stop bridge between them

tongue_cheek_frac.note: saddle cheeks stop 0.8 r above the spar axis

leg_m.note: square leg side, bore; R4: the RIGHT leg (FC side) carries the GPS cable (CR-F2-03 e), the left leg carries nothing

leg_y_m.note: R3: 0.034 -> 0.048 so the pack leads turn left behind the aft stop inboard of the leg

tie_y_m.note: R3: 0.048 -> 0.036 (clear of the moved legs); D1 lays the tie under the spar here (CR-D2-04)

grip_gap_m.note: finger room between the deck and the grip

socket_boss_m.note: mast socket on the grip: outer square, depth, bore square; 6.5 mm counterbore 4.5 deep on +y so the screw grip is 10.0 mm (C6 <= 11.0)

mast_m.note: square side, bore, height above the socket

gps_plate_m.note: GPS pad: square side, thickness, cheek thickness; pad tilted 45 deg toward the nose (normal (-x,+z)/sqrt2), arrow moulded on

socket_m.note: pitot socket: block square, bore (6 mm keyed boom, F3 accepted), length inside the nose wall, collar outside

flange_m.note: socket flange square (>= 30 mm) x thickness, bonded to the nose wall inside face

cable_exit_m.note: aft-wall exits each side: y from, y to, z from, z to (11 x 16 mm, outboard of the handle legs); R4: servo leads only (power and DShot use the side-wall exits, CR-F2-03)

fill.note: effective density fraction: plates <= 3 mm print solid; blocks 3 perimeters + 25 % infill

bought_g.source: EST (catalogue class values; weigh at build, T-D2-WEIGH)
bought_g.note: R4: mast_hw is now a PA66 M3x16 cheese-head screw + PA66 nut (CR-C6-18); fillet_corners = 6 mm microballoon fillets floor-to-side-wall +/-30 mm of each strap (CR-C6-17)

floor_channel_m.note: wire channel across the bay under the pack: centre x, width x, guide-notch height. R5: moved -0.0655 -> -0.0245 because the forward strap now sits over -0.0655; it now lands on the PDB plate (left) and the FC (right), 6 mm behind the forward strap-slot border, 17 mm ahead of the aft one. The tray splits here (10 mm gap down to the foam-board floor, 3.5 mm under the pack); both guides notched 3 mm at the base

side_exit_m.note: side-wall harness exits, both sides (power + DShot to the wing grooves): x from, x to, z from, z to (16 x 12 mm), edges taped

jr_bar_m.note: JR tie bar in the right channel: zone x from, x to; bar x width, height; tie slot width (y), height (z) at the bar foot, 3 slots; six JR in-line plugs tied across it

leg_window_m.note: GPS cable window on the outboard (+y) face of the right handle leg: z from, z to (bore opened to the face)

grip_bore_m.note: GPS cable bore along the grip (y) from the right leg to the mast socket; a 4 mm hole drilled down from the socket floor at y 0 joins it (BUILD step 2)

paper_shear_pa.note: C6 allowable for PETG epoxied to the foam-board paper face

fc_strap_slot_m.note: slot at the root of each FC end stop (y width x z height, 0.5 mm above the plate): a 10 mm hook-and-loop strap loops round the FC through both stops, 1-2 mm slack (secondary retention, 10 N)

tie_post_x_m.note: airspeed tie-post centres from avn_plate_x_m[0]: inner faces 21 mm apart (board 20 mm)

pitot_key_flat_m.note: socket bore key: flat on +z, 5.8 mm from the bore bottom (sleeve flat 5.6, OD 6.0 in the 6.2 bore): total/static cannot swap

pack_x_per_pack_m.note: A1 D-59 flight station per weighed pack (g -> m), met with 2 mm spacer steps: 680 g none (-0.010, on the aft stop), 550 g 8 mm blue (-0.018), 503 g 14 mm blue + green (-0.024). H3 writes the station from A3's roll-up re-run on the balance-test day (CR-A3-27); this table is the D-59 decision, not the live roll-up

spacer_colour.note: PETG filament colour per spacer thickness (H3 writes the stack colours on each pack's flight-card label)

tray_front_solid_m.note: length of solid tray behind the forward stop's fore face (no window): 33 x 55 mm = 1 815 mm2 of bond under the stop (CL-D2-FWD-STOP-BOND), as at R4

nose_ant_tube_in_m.note: antenna B tube length behind the nose wall inside face (block A that held it is gone): bonded in the 6.4 mm wall hole with an epoxy fillet; no load

bridge_x0_m.note: R5: front of the handle foot bridge (the tie between the two feet over the slot fill, |y| < 0.029); it no longer carries the aft stop, so it keeps its R4 extent 0.077 ... 0.0902 (3 mm behind the spar axis)
